_about: The config that shipped the node-panel redesign (stack #597), kept as a worked example. Relative paths resolve from this file.
_sources: The authors' stylesheets, keyed on :root[data-tw-<section>=...]. Concatenated in order.
_axes: The shipped preferences. The default value of each axis is the ABSENCE of its attribute, so the inline script only ever writes non-default values.
_sections: Per tweak section, the owner's pick: one id for every combination ('all'), or one per value of the axis it varies by ('by').
_parts: Per stack part, the axis values that part ships. A selector is kept when it holds for at least one shipped combination.
_rekey: Literal replacements run BEFORE renaming: structural selectors (:has(> section > h4), utility classes) re-keyed onto data hooks the shipped components carry.
_rename: [regex, replacement] pairs: exploration prefixes to the shipped prefix (classes, CSS variables, data-* attributes, keyframes).
_class_prefix: Selectors naming a class with this prefix that no file under 'components' contains are pruned.
_patches: Hand fixes on the generated CSS. Each 'old' must match exactly once, or the run fails.
_appends: Hand-written rules on stable hooks, appended from the listed parts on.
_header: Prepended verbatim: the stylesheet's own doc comment (looks, scoping, hooks, the traps it avoids).
